selected_script.angle: Parent's frustration with nursery changing table clutter solved by an over-the-door 3-tier organizer, fast-cut to bathroom storage
selected_script.hook: A messy pile of diapers and baby wipes falls off a cluttered table onto the nursery floor.

usage_steps_used: Hang the metal hook over the top of a door
Suspend the woven basket assembly by slipping the top rope loop onto the hook
Place items loosely inside the 3 woven basket tiers

timeline.scene: Close-up of a messy changing table with baby items, diapers, and toys falling over onto the nursery floor.
A parent hangs the silver hook over the top of the door and suspends the natural jute 3-tier woven basket from the rope loop.
First-person POV placing baby diapers and wipes neatly into the top tier of the hanging basket.
Fast-cut to the same basket on a bathroom door, with shampoo and skincare items placed inside the bottom tiers.
The 3-tier basket hangs stably, displaying a neat and clean bathroom door setup holding towels.
Text on screen: 'Organize your home effortlessly. Check it out today.'

Keep product color Natural Jute/Tan, curved stacked structure, and rope texture identical to the reference image. Do not end with a CTA in this segment.
